content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P0 detected - decode node OOM spike in us-west-2. thread started 2495006789
maria: paging oncall-sre, seeing a spike of container restarts on decode pool, ~12 restarts in 10m, ~5% request drops reported by gateway
sam: looking... logs show repeated CUDA OOMs in decode loop, possible runaway generation from clients with bad max_tokens override
raj: any recent config change to token caps? I pushed a change yesterday to permissive max_token header handling
maria: yes, there was a change: we allowed client-specified max_tokens up to 16384 if not set. suspect = misconfig + adversarial request
jen: support reported customers A & B saw 503/504s, volume small but realtime apps impacted
leo: mitigation plan: 1) enable server-side hard cap 2048 tokens, 2) enable early reject for seq>cap, 3) set fallback to quantized-cpu model for affected pods
sam: applying hotpatch: updating configmap inference-config.max_gen_tokens=2048 then rolling restart decode-deployment (canary first)
sam: running command:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/decode-deployment MAX_GEN_TOKENS=2048 && kubectl rollout restart deployment/decode-deployment -n inference
```
maria: oncall handoff ETA 5m, canary pods coming up
deploy-bot: rollout started: deployment/decode-deployment (revision 57 -> 58)
sam: logs tail show crash trace:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.27 GiB (GPU 0; 10.92 GiB total capacity; 8.34 GiB already allocated)
  File "/srv/runtime/decode.py", line 432, in decode_step
    kv_cache.append(tokens)
```
raj: that matches runaway generation: client X sent prompt with `max_tokens=100000` and we weren't enforcing, streaming kept allocating
maria: rolling back yesterday's permissive change as well
sam: I've enabled request throttling at edge for users exceeding 2 req/s per key
leo: fallback route configured: requests matching `accepts-low-latency=false` flow to quantized-cpu; testing looks stable
jen: customers A & B notified, CS escalated timeline
maria: impact summary: ~0.7% overall request drop last 20m, ~100 affected realtime sessions, no data plane leakage
sam: postmortem items: (1) reintroduce hard server-side max token enforcement (2) add detection for header anomalies (3) automated rollback on node OOM spike
maria: oncall handoff: @raj will take next shift, I'm documenting runbook in incidents/ and will follow up tomorrow
raj: ack, will monitor metrics and finalize postmortem draft
maria: closing thread and creating incident ticket INC-2026-3842
incident-bot: incident P0 -> P1 at 2495006905 (mitigated)
maria: last note: add unit tests for header parsing and reject invalid >10000 tokens
